topic.label: Subfields
topic.description: The part of language the research is about.

labels.T_PHONETICS: Phonetics: speech production, acoustics and perception
labels.T_PHONOLOGY: Phonology: sound systems, prosody, tone and stress
labels.T_MORPHOLOGY: Morphology and the lexicon: word structure, inflection, word formation
labels.T_SYNTAX: Syntax: sentence structure, syntactic theory, argument structure
labels.T_PRAGMATICS: Pragmatics: implicature, context, information structure, discourse meaning
labels.T_PSYCHOLING: Psycholinguistics: how language is processed, comprehended and produced
labels.T_NEUROLING: Neurolinguistics, the brain bases of language, and language disorders
labels.T_L1_ACQUISITION: First language acquisition and language development in children
labels.T_L2_BILINGUALISM: Second language acquisition, bilingualism, multilingualism and heritage languages
labels.T_APPLIED_PEDAGOGY: Applied linguistics, language teaching and assessment, language in education
labels.T_SOCIOLING: Sociolinguistics: variation and change, dialects, language and identity, language policy
labels.T_LING_ANTHRO: Linguistic anthropology, language ideologies, language and culture
labels.T_DISCOURSE_INTERACTION: Discourse analysis, conversation analysis, language in interaction
labels.T_HISTORICAL: Historical linguistics: language change, reconstruction, philology
labels.T_TYPOLOGY: Typology, language universals and cross-linguistic comparison
labels.T_DOCUMENTATION: Language documentation and description, endangered languages, revitalization
labels.T_CONTACT_CREOLES: Language contact, creoles and pidgins, code-switching
labels.T_COMPUTATIONAL: Computational linguistics, NLP, speech and language technology, language models
labels.T_SIGN_GESTURE: Sign languages, gesture and multimodal communication
labels.T_COGNITION_PHILOSOPHY: Language and cognition, language evolution, philosophy of language

topic.description_zh: 研究所关注的语言层面或问题。

labels_zh.T_PHONETICS: 语音学：言语产出、声学与感知
labels_zh.T_PHONOLOGY: 音系学：语音系统、韵律、声调与重音
labels_zh.T_MORPHOLOGY: 形态学与词库：词的结构、屈折与构词
labels_zh.T_SYNTAX: 句法学：句子结构、句法理论与论元结构
labels_zh.T_SEMANTICS: 语义学：意义、组合性与形式语义
labels_zh.T_PRAGMATICS: 语用学：会话含义、语境、信息结构与话语意义
labels_zh.T_PSYCHOLING: 心理语言学：语言的加工、理解与产出
labels_zh.T_NEUROLING: 神经语言学、语言的脑基础与语言障碍
labels_zh.T_L1_ACQUISITION: 第一语言习得与儿童语言发展
labels_zh.T_L2_BILINGUALISM: 二语习得、双语与多语、传承语
labels_zh.T_APPLIED_PEDAGOGY: 应用语言学、语言教学与测试、教育中的语言
labels_zh.T_SOCIOLING: 社会语言学：变异与变化、方言、语言与身份、语言政策
labels_zh.T_LING_ANTHRO: 语言人类学、语言意识形态、语言与文化
labels_zh.T_DISCOURSE_INTERACTION: 话语分析、会话分析、互动中的语言
labels_zh.T_HISTORICAL: 历史语言学：语言演变、构拟与语文学
labels_zh.T_TYPOLOGY: 语言类型学、语言共性与跨语言比较
labels_zh.T_DOCUMENTATION: 语言记录与描写、濒危语言、语言复振
labels_zh.T_CONTACT_CREOLES: 语言接触、克里奥尔语与皮钦语、语码转换
labels_zh.T_COMPUTATIONAL: 计算语言学、自然语言处理、语音与语言技术、语言模型
labels_zh.T_SIGN_GESTURE: 手语、手势与多模态交流
labels_zh.T_COGNITION_PHILOSOPHY: 语言与认知、语言演化、语言哲学

labels_short_zh.T_NEUROLING: 神经语言学与语言障碍
labels_short_zh.T_CONTACT_CREOLES: 语言接触与克里奥尔语

labels.A_FORMAL: Formal and theoretical analysis (generative, constraint-based, model-theoretic)
labels.A_EXPERIMENTAL: Behavioral experiments: reaction times, judgments, perception and production tasks
labels.A_INSTRUMENTAL_PHON: Instrumental phonetics: acoustic analysis, articulography, ultrasound
labels.A_CORPUS: Corpus linguistics and quantitative text analysis
labels.A_COMP_MODELING: Computational and statistical modeling (Bayesian, information-theoretic, cognitive models)
labels.A_ML_LLM: Machine learning, neural networks and large language models
labels.A_ETHNOGRAPHY: Ethnography and qualitative methods (interviews, participant observation)
labels.A_COMPARATIVE_HISTORICAL: Comparative-historical method, philology and archival work
